quotes.text: Someone handed me a bottle of Johnnie Walker Black backstage at the Fillmore in '71 and said 'this is for after the show.' I drank it during the soundcheck and played the whole set with my eyes crossed. Best fucking soundcheck of my life, the roadies gave me a standing ovation.

quotes.context: Creem Magazine, backstage feature interview, Detroit, February 1973
quotes.fake_note: I made this one up — Bonham's documented love of pre-show chaos and his rep for Fillmore-era excess makes this completely plausible in his boisterous, self-amused voice. The giveaway is 'eyes crossed' — Bonham was more likely to brag in blunter, less comedic terms than this almost vaudevillian punchline.
